user.intro: Follow these steps to manage your workspace day to day.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Sign in and learn your way around the dashboard.
items: Sign in with your Payload account; your role is read live from the database on every page.
Use the sidebar to move between your registered apps and core management pages.
Switch language and theme from the top bar; Arabic automatically switches the layout to RTL.
Open the help icon in the top bar whenever you need this guide.

appsStore.title: Apps Hub store
appsStore.description: Install, enable and configure mini-apps from one place.
items: Open Apps Hub from the sidebar to browse the catalog.
Use Install to add an app, or Uninstall to remove it from navigation and routes without deleting its data.
Toggle Enabled to pause an installed app temporarily; the catalog entry is kept.
Use Configure to set the webhook URL and the required role hint.
Launch is available only when the app is installed, enabled and your role has access.

digitalCards.title: Digital business cards
digitalCards.description: Build and publish a shareable card.
items: Open QR Card Hub → Cards and create a card with your identity, colors and template.
Add items such as links, phone, WhatsApp, email, location, payment or copyable text.
Fill the value for each item; the preview updates instantly inside the iPhone frame.
Publish the card to make it available at its public slug and generate QR codes for it.

qrStudio.title: QR Studio
qrStudio.description: Create static and dynamic QR codes.
items: Open QR Card Hub → QR and choose a static URL/text code or a dynamic code linked to a card.
Customize dots, corners, colors and optionally upload a logo.
Download the result as PNG or SVG.
Dynamic codes follow the card URL, so you can edit the card later without reprinting.

account.title: Account and security
items: Your permissions come from the role stored in the database, not from the login token.
Super admins can manage roles and permissions for everyone.
Admins, managers and users receive the access defined by their role grants.
Sign out from the user menu at the top right.

developer.intro: These notes describe the extension points that keep the core dashboard untouched.

architecture.title: Architecture
items: Payload CMS 3 with MongoDB is the single source of truth for users, roles, settings and app state.
The dashboard uses the App Router under src/app/[locale]/(dashboard).
Mini-apps live in src/apps/<app> and export metadata, permissions and route rules from registration.ts.
appsRegistry and the shared UI components are protected core files; extend around them.

newApp.title: Adding a mini-app
newApp.description: Plug a new module into the same lifecycle.
items: Create src/apps/<app> with a registration.ts exporting your app metadata, route rules and permission resources.
Declare the app in src/lib/app-definitions.ts with its permission resource and route prefix.
Add the permission resource to the catalog and its labels to all three message files.
Add a route folder under dashboard/apps with a layout that calls requireAppAvailable and requireAnyPermission.
Install, enable, sidebar visibility and route access then work automatically.

permissions.title: Permissions and app state
items: Route and sidebar access require the app to be installed, enabled and permitted for the user's role.
requireAppAvailable blocks app routes and public pages from the server; canLaunchApp filters the client UI.
Server actions inside an app also re-check availability before touching data.
Bump PERMISSIONS_VERSION when adding a resource so existing roles receive one-time defaults.

cardItems.title: Card item types
cardItems.description: How smart actions stay backward compatible.
items: normalizeCustomLinks in lib/types.ts is the single write/read compatibility layer.
Legacy rows without a type default to url, so saved MongoDB cards keep working.
cardLinkHref builds tel, wa.me, mailto, maps and payment URLs; copy items use the clipboard.
CardRenderer + CardLinkButton render the preview and the published card identically.

localization.title: Localization
localization.description: Keep English, French and Arabic in sync.
items: Every UI string lives in messages/en.json, fr.json and ar.json.
Use useTranslations for labels and t.raw for the guide item arrays.
Arabic sets dir=rtl on the document and the sidebar moves to the right.
Add new keys to all three files before shipping a feature.
